description: Intent i016 (fixed-epidx-rest, snapshot s04) complete. FINDING (high confidence): drivers/usb/atm/ueagle-atm.c lines 2204-2210, function uea_boot: `usb_fill_int_urb(sc->urb_int, sc->usb_dev, usb_rcvintpipe(sc->usb_dev, UEA_INTR_PIPE), intr, size, uea_intr, sc, sc->usb_dev->actconfig->interface[0]->altsetting[0].endpoint[0].desc.bInterval);` — a probe-time fixed-index read of the untrusted USB descriptor endpoint array (interface 0, altsetting 0, endpoint 0) with NO bNumEndpoints validation anywhere in the file (grep count 0). uea_boot is reached at device plug-in via usbatm_usb_probe -> driver->bind (uea_bind, which only checks bInterfaceNumber and claims interfaces) -> uea_boot; the usbatm core also never validates interface 0's endpoints, programming pipes from static driver constants. A malicious gadget declaring bNumEndpoints==0 on interface 0 makes this read run past the flex-array for an OOB kernel-memory read whose value is installed as the URB polling interval and the URB is immediately submitted — the same untrusted descriptor-count vs assumed-index invariant as the seed cx231xx NULL-deref. Evidence-backed negatives: 14 other fixed-index candidates classified safe with exact guards (qcserial.c bNumEndpoints==2 before endpoint[0]/[1]; uss720.c <3; wa-hc.c <3; aiptek/gtco/iforce/ims-pcu/diolan/dln2/bfusb/cdc-acm/cdc-wdm/idmouse/lvstest/hub/usbtmc all guarded; staging comedi dt9812/ni_usb6501/vmk80xx, most hdm-usb, greybus es2, rtl8188eu all use bNumEndpoints-bounded loops; usb-storage alauda.c's unguarded endpoint[0] is covered by the core get_pipes() sanity check that fails probes with no bulk endpoints before transport attach). One unresolved: drivers/isdn/gigaset/usb-gigaset.c lines 708/727 endpoint[0]/endpoint[1] reads with no bNumEndpoints reference found in the file, but the surrounding function was not fully line-verified. Limitations: bounded to non-media/non-net USB consumers, endpoint-index patterns only; no runtime reproducer compiled (static source hypothesis with grep-level counterevidence).
